statement: Zariski cancellation and affine fibrations over the complex numbers. Constructs an integral complex affine fourfold $`X\not\cong\mathbb A^4`$ with $`X\times\mathbb A^1\cong\mathbb A^5`$, disproving affine-space cancellation over ℂ in dimension four. It also disproves the Dolgachev–Weisfeiler affine-fibration conjecture: smooth surjections $`X\to\mathbb A^1`$ and $`\mathbb A^5\to\mathbb A^2`$ have every residue-field fiber isomorphic to affine three-space but are not Zariski-locally trivial.
